claim.claim-text: 1. A mobile communication system which is configured to use a carrier aggregation aggregating a plurality of subcarriers to carry out radio communication between a mobile terminal and a base station,

wherein the mobile terminal is configured to report the base station measurement results of reception quality using CQI when data is transmitted and received using one subcarrier among the plurality of subcarriers, wherein the mobile terminal is configured to not report the base station the measurement results of the reception quality using CQI when data is not transmitted and received using the one subcarrier.
2. A mobile terminal which is configured to use a carrier aggregation aggregating a plurality of subcarriers to carry out radio communication with a base station,

wherein the mobile terminal is configured to report the base station measurement results of reception quality using CQI when data is transmitted and received using one subcarrier among the plurality of subcarriers, wherein the mobile terminal is configured to not report the base station the measurement results of the reception quality using CQI when data is not transmitted and received using the one subcarrier.
3. A base station which is configured to use a carrier aggregation aggregating a plurality of subcarriers to carry out radio communication with a mobile terminal,

wherein the base station is configured to receive from the mobile terminal measurement results of reception quality using CQI when data is transmitted and received using one subcarrier among the plurality of subcarriers, wherein the base station is configured to not receive from the mobile terminal the measurement results of the reception quality using CQI when data is not transmitted and received using the one subcarrier.
